full_judgment: 13. It is in evidence of PW 1 that there were about 20/30 local people at the place of occurrence. PW 2 stated that 100/200 people were at the place of occurrence. But none of them has either been cited as a witness or examined in the case and the prosecution has also not examined the informant of the case, for which adverse presumption as to the alleged prosecution case and the place of occurrence can be safely drawn against the prosecution case.
